newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Government to cancel public television station.
National Taiwan University to grant two days off per week for all students and professors starting next semester.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - U.S. attorney general, tobacco makers reach secret agreement.
President Lee Teng-hui says amending of Constitution should not cater to interests of one party.
LIBERTY TIMES - Prosecutor demands 10 years in prison for leader of school for "qigong" inner energy studies accused of fraud.
Taiwan National Security Bureau chief says war will not break out between sides of Taiwan strait within next five years.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry finishes amending regulations guiding planned streamlining of business tax.
Government to speed up privatisation scheme for state-run firms.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Attention focused on when direct shipping links will commence between Taiwan and China.
Government loosens ceiling for labour insurance coverage.
